summary: Send `message` on socket `s`. In STREAM or MUD mode, the socket must already be connected and `address` must not be specified. In DATAGRAM mode, `address` is required and has a format such as "127.0.0.1 23".
details:
Return semantics:
Return EESUCCESS on success. On failure, return a negative value with one of these meanings:

Errors

EEFDRANGE      Socket descriptor out of range
   EEBADF         Invalid socket descriptor
   EESECURITY     Attempt to violate security
   EENOADDR       Socket has no bound address
   EEBADADDR      Invalid address format
   EENOTCONN      Socket is not connected
   EEALREADY      Operation is already in progress
   EETYPENOTSUPP  Unsupported object type
   EEBADDATA      Data to send is nested too deeply
   EESENDTO       Problem with sendto
   EEMODENOTSUPP  Unsupported socket mode
   EEWOULDBLOCK   Operation would block
   EESEND         Problem with send
   EECALLBACK     Waiting for a callback
